submit-readable-output.description: sr submit output is a report of what was pushed and which PRs exist, without git's push/fetch transcript; metadata push honors --no-verify

context.text: Quiet fetch and push at the wrapper level; --quiet leaves lease rejections and remote hook messages intact, verified by probing git directly

Local pre-push hook output is the user's and still prints once per pushed branch; not suppressed. Unconditional --no-verify on the metadata push was considered and rejected — a pre-push hook may be policy, so only the user's explicit flag skips it
